title: Seerah of the Holy Prophet (PBUH)
lines: USAT Seerah questions ask about the life of the Holy Prophet (PBUH): his family, early life, the Makkan period, the Hijrah, the battles and treaties of Madinah, and his last days. Most questions ask for a name, a place or a year. A clear timeline is the best tool.
## Early life
- Born in Makkah in the Year of the Elephant (about 570 CE), into the Banu Hashim clan of the Quraysh tribe.
- His father Abdullah died before his birth. He spent early childhood with his wet nurse Halimah Sa'diyah among the Banu Sa'd.
- His mother Aminah bint Wahb died when he was about six. His grandfather Abdul Muttalib cared for him until his death about two years later; then his uncle Abu Talib.
- At about twelve he travelled with Abu Talib to Syria on a trade journey. Known for honesty, he was called Al-Amin (the Trustworthy) and As-Sadiq (the Truthful).
- He took part in Hilf al-Fudul, a pact to protect the wronged, and settled the dispute over placing the Black Stone when the Kaaba was rebuilt.
- At 25 he married Khadijah (RA), a respected merchant whose trade he had managed.
## The Makkan period (about 13 years)
| Year (approx.) | Event
| 610 CE, age 40 | first revelation in the Cave of Hira
| first 3 years | private call; early Muslims include Khadijah, Abu Bakr, Ali and Zayd ibn Haritha (RA); Dar al-Arqam used for teaching
| from about year 3 | public preaching; persecution of Bilal, Sumayyah and others
| 5th year | first migration to Abyssinia, where the Negus (Najashi) gave refuge
| 7th–10th year | boycott of Banu Hashim in Shi'b Abi Talib
| 10th year | Year of Sorrow: deaths of Khadijah (RA) and Abu Talib; journey to Ta'if
| before the Hijrah | Isra and Mi'raj; the five daily prayers prescribed
| 621 and 622 CE | first and second Pledges of Aqabah with people of Yathrib
## The Hijrah

- In 622 CE the Prophet (PBUH) migrated to Yathrib, later called Madinat an-Nabi (Madinah). Ali (RA) slept in his bed on the night he left; he and Abu Bakr (RA) hid for three nights in the Cave of Thawr.
- At Quba he built the first mosque, then the Prophet's Mosque (Masjid an-Nabawi) in Madinah.
- The migrants were the Muhajirun; the Muslims of Madinah who helped them were the Ansar. The Prophet (PBUH) joined them in brotherhood (mu'akhat).
- The Charter of Madinah set out the rights and duties of the Muslims, the Jewish tribes and others in the city.
- The Hijrah marks year 1 of the Islamic (Hijri) calendar, adopted later under Umar (RA).
## The Madinan period (10 years)
| Year | Event
| 2 AH | change of qibla to the Kaaba; fasting and zakat made obligatory; Battle of Badr (313 Muslims against about 1,000)
| 3 AH | Battle of Uhud; archers left their post
| 5 AH | Battle of the Trench (Khandaq), on Salman al-Farsi's (RA) advice
| 6 AH | Treaty of Hudaybiyyah; Bay'at ar-Ridwan
| 7 AH | Khaybar; letters (sent after Hudaybiyyah) inviting rulers to Islam
| 8 AH | Battle of Mu'tah; conquest of Makkah with a general amnesty; Battle of Hunayn
| 9 AH | Expedition of Tabuk; Year of Delegations
| 10 AH | Farewell Hajj and Farewell Sermon
| 11 AH (632 CE) | passing away in Madinah at age 63, buried in the room of Aisha (RA)
> In which year after the Hijrah was the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah signed?  (A) 4 AH  (B) 5 AH  (C) 6 AH  (D) 8 AH
> C. Remember the order Badr 2, Uhud 3, Trench 5, Hudaybiyyah 6, Makkah 8.
> The Farewell Sermon taught that  (A) Arabs are superior to non-Arabs  (B) no one is superior except by piety and good action  (C) wealth decides status  (D) tribes should keep old feuds
> B. The sermon declared human equality and cancelled feuds and interest from the days of ignorance.
## Family
- Wives include Khadijah, Sawdah, Aisha, Hafsa, Umm Salamah and Zaynab (RA). His son Ibrahim was born to Mariyah al-Qibtiyyah (RA) and died in infancy.
- Daughters: Zaynab, Ruqayyah, Umm Kulthum and Fatimah (RA). Fatimah (RA) married Ali (RA); their sons were Hasan and Husain (RA).
## Traps
! The first mosque was Quba, not Masjid an-Nabawi.
! The Cave of Hira is linked with revelation; the Cave of Thawr with the Hijrah.
! The conquest of Makkah was in 8 AH, two years after Hudaybiyyah, not 10 AH.
## Quick check
- Born about 570 CE; revelation 610 CE at 40; Hijrah 622 CE; passed away 11 AH at 63.
- Badr 2, Uhud 3, Khandaq 5, Hudaybiyyah 6, Khaybar 7, Makkah 8, Tabuk 9, Farewell Hajj 10.
- Caves: Hira (revelation), Thawr (Hijrah). First mosque: Quba.
